title: Stone Wave Cliffs - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: Stone Wave Cliffs in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: The area that closes Act 1 and hosts Lampmaster, the game's first genuine difficulty spike. It also holds the Coralim and Delaram weapons and a large set of Paint Cages.

sections.title: How to Reach Stone Wave Cliffs
sections.content: Reached at the end of Act 1 after the Flying Waters. Clear side content before advancing, because Act 2 shifts the party around.

sections.title: Bosses Here
sections.content: Lampmaster, Bourgeon, Mime, Rare Sakapatate variants, Hexga, Chalier, Chation, Rangeson
